literal: Virtue ocean gracious-one feet to-those-who-reached except, other oceans swimming difficult.
translation: Except for those who have reached the feet of the gracious one who is an ocean of virtue, it is difficult to cross the other oceans.
modern: அறக்கடலாக விளங்கும் அந்தணனின் திருவடிகளைச் சேர்ந்தவர்களுக்கு அல்லாமல், மற்றவர்களுக்குப் பிற கடல்களை நீந்திக் கடப்பது கடினம்.
explanation: The couplet describes the divine as an ocean of virtue and a gracious being. The word ஆழி can mean a wheel or an ocean, but ocean best fits the context of swimming (நீந்தல்) mentioned later in the couplet. It states that only those who reach the feet of this gracious one can cross the ocean of life. For anyone else, swimming across the other oceans of worldly existence is exceedingly difficult.
